beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The novel adds inhabitants who can reject their visitors’ explanations.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Their deadlines and loyalties exceed whatever a convenient category records.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with Why a periodic table rather than a list of tropes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then enter The Room Where Surprise No Longer Existed.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Compare what the atlas names with what its inhabitants still dispute.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its literary references let readers trace the traditions behind each encounter.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The reward is learning how inventions alter lives, not just landscapes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The novel asks who gets to decide what those lives mean.
